_comment: Concatenation order for the bundled userscript. This is deliberately a
hand-maintained list rather than a topological sort of the import graph:
the graph contains legitimate cycles (storage <-> collections,
osu-api <-> gist-backup, main-panel <-> floating-heart), which a
topological sort cannot order at all. Function declarations hoist, so
those cycles are harmless at runtime - but `const`/`let` module state does
NOT hoist, so the order below matters and is kept identical to the section
order of the original single-file script, which is known to work.
build.js fails if this list and the files on disk under src/ disagree in
either direction, so adding a module without placing it here is a build
error rather than a silent omission from the bundle.
